business_decision.name: Drogon DG0 - Business Case Maturity
business_decision.description: DG0 business-case maturity for the Drogon prospect. Valysar formation in Volantis Group, 7 fault-bounded segments. Pre-drill analogue-based volumetric estimate, geological risk screening, and strategic fit assessment. Recommends proceed to DG1 Concept Selection.
business_decision.decision_summary: Screen Drogon prospect for field development potential. Analogue-based STOIIP estimate 25–45 MSm³ oil in Valysar formation. 7 fault-bounded segments identified from seismic interpretation. Strategic fit confirmed (Snorre area infrastructure). Approve proceed to DG1 Concept Selection with initial FMU volumetric assessment.

risks.name: Drogon DG0 – Prospect Risk (Trap & Seal)
risks.description: Risk that the Valysar prospect does not contain a viable hydrocarbon accumulation. Key elements: 4-way dip closure on Top Brent may be breached by sub-seismic faults; seal effectiveness of Upper Volantis shales uncertain at burial depth >3500 m; hydrocarbon charge timing relative to trap formation. Pre-drill Pg estimate ~0.65 based on regional analogues.
risks.mitigation: Seismic reprocessing for fault detection; AVO analysis for fluid discrimination; regional seal study from offset wells.

risks.name: Drogon DG0 – Data Maturity & Analogue Dependency
risks.description: Risk that pre-drill subsurface understanding is insufficient for reliable volumetric and concept screening. No well penetration in Valysar at DG0; reservoir properties (porosity, NTG, Sw) based on Snorre/Statfjord analogues. Seismic depth conversion uncertainty ±50 m at reservoir level. OWC position inferred from regional pressure gradients only.
risks.mitigation: Plan exploration/appraisal well with core + MDT program; acquire velocity survey for depth calibration; commission analogue study from Snorre Brent reservoir.

risks.name: Drogon DG0 – Commercial Viability
risks.description: Risk that the Drogon development is not commercially viable under realistic oil price and cost scenarios. Analogue-based STOIIP range 25–45 MSm³ with recovery factor 20–35% yields EUR 5–16 MSm³. Breakeven oil price estimated 45–65 USD/bbl depending on concept. CAPEX uncertainty ±40% at screening stage.
risks.mitigation: Run economic screening with P10/P50/P90 volumes × 3 oil price scenarios; benchmark CAPEX against recent subsea tie-backs in Tampen area; confirm host platform capacity and availability.

risks.name: Drogon DG0 – Infrastructure Access & Tie-back
risks.description: Risk that suitable host infrastructure is unavailable or uneconomic for a Drogon tie-back. Nearest candidates: Njord A (semi-sub, 15 km), Draugen (concrete, 25 km). Host platform processing capacity, remaining field life, and flow assurance all uncertain at DG0.
risks.mitigation: Host platform capacity study; flow assurance screening (wax appearance, hydrate curve); pipeline routing desktop study; engage host platform operator for capacity reservation.
